experience.title: Full-Stack Developer
experience.description: As a full-stack developer, I integrate external systems with legacy platforms through APIs and RPA bots, and build reporting modules and optimized database views for sales and core business processes. I took ownership of the company's Python and Playwright automations after the previous owner left, saving over 4 hours of manual work per day. I also implemented two-factor authentication (2FA) for the core system and refactored its security implementation to address identified vulnerabilities.

experience.title: Software Developer
experience.description: As a software developer, I built new user interfaces with React and Firebase, as well as REST APIs with ExpressJS that used Firebase Admin to add an extra security layer and handle Firebase triggers. I automated deployments to Firebase Hosting and Functions with GitHub Actions, including unit and end-to-end tests with Playwright, optimized Firebase queries to keep billing under control, and integrated third-party services such as Brevo and the OpenAI API.

experience.title: Software Developer Intern
experience.description: As a software developer intern, I collaborated with an external development team, completing tasks under the Scrum methodology with React and Firebase while aligning the applications with the client's decisions and requirements.

experience.title: Freelance Developer
experience.description: As a freelance developer, I built an enrollment system for a high school using React, NestJS, and MySQL, working directly with the client and the development team. I implemented real-time communication with WebSockets to update section availability dynamically, created stored procedures for reporting, and delivered the project with Docker.
